title: Result review scorecard (outputs, visualizations, report)
score_scale: 0-5 per point; weights are fractions of the area total

points.title: Output contract compliance
points.guidance: Every scored case output dir contains metadata.json, partition_diagnostics.csv/.json, residuals.csv, forces.csv, surface.csv, field_final.*, restart_final.*, stdout.log, run_status.json with required headers/schema; completed=true; run_status matches reality.
points.evidence: Directory listing per case; header check; validate_outputs.py --report.

points.title: Automated validator results
points.guidance: validate_outputs.py passes for the submission; validator run included in the workspace or report; any failures explained or fixed.

points.title: Case completion and convergence
points.guidance: All required NACA0012 and cylinder cases completed: inviscid converged/plateaued, laminar converged, Re 20 steady wake, Re 200 statistically periodic; no placeholder/partial/synthetic result files; final rows finite and consistent.
points.evidence: run_status.json + metadata.json per case; residual/force tails; result_statistics.json if present.

points.title: Result plausibility and MPI consistency
points.guidance: Min density/pressure positive; inviscid viscous forces negligible; wall velocities near zero; force histories comparable across np=1/2/4/8; Re 200 shows vortex street and shedding frequency/Strouhal estimate.
points.evidence: Forces/residuals/surface CSVs; rank comparison dirs; report analysis.

points.title: Visualizations
points.guidance: Mach AND pressure computed-field figures for main body cases with correct filenames, colorbars, captions, adequate resolution (not scatter-only/tiny/unlabeled); line plots publication-style with labeled axes/legends; Re 200 wake-focused vorticity/velocity figure.
points.evidence: Figures dir + figure_manifest.csv; render a sample; compare with source data.

points.title: Report quality and honesty
points.guidance: Governing equations, nondimensionalization, BCs, schemes accurately described with formulas; histories for all cases; convergence/vortex-street/MPI/limitations analyzed honestly with tables and figure references; reproducible artifacts.
points.evidence: report.pdf/report.tex review; cross-check claims vs metadata and CSVs.

points.title: Traceability of figures and claims
points.guidance: Every figure tied to source data via manifest or equivalent; every reported coefficient traceable to forces.csv; residual reduction traceable to residuals.csv; final forces row corresponds to final field/surface state.
points.evidence: figure_manifest.csv; spot-check values in text vs CSVs.

disqualification_flags: Figure files misnamed (e.g., Mach image that actually plots pressure)
Report figures do not correspond to submitted field/CSV outputs
Placeholder, synthetic, or intentionally partial result files in scored case dirs
metadata.json marks incomplete or failed runs as successful
Debug outputs presented as final case results
